verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents refunds through its API. There is a 'Refund a payment' guide (with- and without-reference variants), an idempotent /payments/{id}/refunds endpoint, and the MCP server can issue refunds. The evidence never shows refunds being issued from the Dashboard UI, and never explicitly distinguishes full from partial amounts. missing for 10: evidence of Dashboard-based refund issuance, explicit documentation of partial vs full refund amounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
